wasteland radio operator, far-future, rendered as screenprint concept art moodboard, high-contrast teal-and-orange, wet river stone

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'wasteland radio operator, far-future, rendered as screenprint'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Lighting reference: a large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
